The bidder shall have to submit a copy of the last (latest) purchase order for the tendere d/similar item(s) received by them from any Organization/Ministry/Department of the Govt. of India or Coal India Ltd. and/or its Subsidiaries or other PSU or any other private organizat ion, along with the offer. c. The format of Ba nk Guarantee is mentioned below. i. The ePBG mentioned in the Bid is to be treated as Security Deposit. ii. Security Deposit will be released with the approval of the HOD of MM Department/Area GM within 30 days after completion of supplies and acceptance of material by the consigne e. vii. ed Tenders. viii.
